title: Thin the alethiometer case within clearance and relief rules, with consistent documents
derivation: Public hardware-branch commit 4528e96 (5 mm hand standoffs, 1.5 mm crystal clearance, P2 hinge relief widened to clear screw tips, README/BOM/ASSEMBLY updates). The CAD module needs cadquery/shapely, so its Z stack-up and hinge-relief constants are excerpted verbatim into a stdlib model; document excerpts are lightly normalized to be consistent with that model (upper-shell flange stated as the model's shell height). v2 (MB-010c follow-up): native admission audit of v1 found the oracle README stated 37.0 mm while the model computes 36.949 mm (36.9 mm at the required 0.1 mm precision), masked by a 0.06 mm check tolerance. The oracle now states 36.9/44.6 mm, the instruction requires half-up rounding at each document's precision, and every document number is checked for exact equality with the rounded model value; model-value checks keep sub-0.01 mm tolerances.
coverage: Constraint validator over a multi-file design change: optimal catalog choice, perturbation-tested relief derivation, preserved fixed parts, and exact rounded document/model consistency.
residual_rubric: Physical manufacturability beyond the stated rules (renders, DXF/STEP regeneration) is out of scope and not graded.
